paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Cryogenic Penning-trap (BASE) haloscope using superconducting LC detection circuit. Constrains g_agamma < 1e-11 GeV^-1 over a narrow ALP mass band 2.7906-2.7914 neV at 95% CL, assuming local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Reported as a flat coupling limit over the narrow mass range; encoded as horizontal line spanning the stated band. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.55, 28)) | Vision: Figure 3(a) is the 95% CL exclusion for this work over m_a = 2.7905-2.7915 neV/c^2 (x linear), y = g_agamma 1e-12 to 1e-9 log. This experiment's exclusion is the wavy blue/purple band whose lower edge sits near 1e-11 GeV^-1, consistent with the abstract limit g_agamma < 1e-11. The band spans only ~2.79057-2.79148 neV. Points are the wavy lower boundary of the BASE band; other colored regions (SN-1987A, CAST, FERMI-LAT red at ~5e-12, ABRACADABRA, SHAFT) are external limits overlaid.
